exposure: availability of female skilled birth personnel
cohort: 404 mothers of children under two years old in Gambella Regional State, Ethiopia
finding: Maternal education, ethnicity, attitude, transport accessibility, availability of maternal health information, availability of female skilled birth personnel, antenatal care visits, and access to 24-hour services were significantly associated with institutional delivery.
followup_time: Children were under two years of age at the time of the study
